info.about: ALCOR is an anime and manga discovery website with a private media library. It does not host videos or manga chapters.
info.help: Browse titles without signing in. Personal library and progress features require a configured account. Scores and publication details come from the attributed metadata source.
info.sources: Development metadata was retrieved from Tenrai, using MyAnimeList identifiers. Artwork remains attributed to its source. Provider selection and redistribution rights must be reviewed before public launch.
info.privacy: Development notice: account data is private by design. A reviewed production privacy notice, retention policy, and account deletion workflow are required before public launch.
info.terms: This is a development build. Production terms and metadata usage permissions have not been approved.
info.status: This development build uses a finite catalogue snapshot. Live provider service and Google sign-in are not implied by this page.
